eval_agent_import_intents_receipt_ck.name: eval_agent_import_intents_receipt_ck
eval_agent_import_intents_receipt_ck.value: "eval_agent_import_intents"."status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'completed') OR "eval_agent_import_intents"."receipt" IS NOT NULL

eval_attempt_resources_record_ck.name: eval_attempt_resources_record_ck
eval_attempt_resources_record_ck.value: ("eval_attempt_resources"."stage" = 'execution' AND "eval_attempt_resources"."evaluation_id" IS NULL AND "eval_attempt_resources"."record_id" = "eval_attempt_resources"."sampling_id") OR ("eval_attempt_resources"."stage" = 'evaluation' AND "eval_attempt_resources"."evaluation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "eval_attempt_resources"."record_id" = "eval_attempt_resources"."evaluation_id")

eval_management_operations_identity_ck.name: eval_management_operations_identity_ck
eval_management_operations_identity_ck.value:
length("eval_management_operations"."owner_user_id") > 0
    AND length("eval_management_operations"."operation_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "eval_management_operations"."fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND ("eval_management_operations"."kind" = 'skill') = ("eval_management_operations"."skill_name" IS NOT NULL)

eval_management_uploads_metadata_ck.name: eval_management_uploads_metadata_ck
eval_management_uploads_metadata_ck.value:
length("eval_management_uploads"."owner_user_id") > 0
    AND length("eval_management_uploads"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length("eval_management_uploads"."media_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 200
    AND "eval_management_uploads"."byte_size" > 0 AND "eval_management_uploads"."byte_size" <= 20971520 AND "eval_management_uploads"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND ("eval_management_uploads"."claimed_by" IS NULL OR length("eval_management_uploads"."claimed_by") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

eval_resource_sources_proof_ck.name: eval_resource_sources_proof_ck
eval_resource_sources_proof_ck.value:
"eval_resource_sources"."origin" = 'eval_native' OR (
    "eval_resource_sources"."source_connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "eval_resource_sources"."source_user_id" IS NOT NULL
    AND "eval_resource_sources"."source_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "eval_resource_sources"."applied_target_digest" IS NOT NULL
    AND ("eval_resource_sources"."origin" = 'platform_catalog' OR "eval_resource_sources"."receipt" IS NOT NULL))
